description: Dataset descriptor for Indian Railway station operational status. Tracks whether stations are active, closed, under construction, or decommissioned.
notes: Depends on station_codes because status records reference station code identifiers. No dedicated schema has been defined yet — schema_reference is intentionally left empty until a station_status_schema is created. No URLs, API endpoints, resource IDs, or download logic are included — those belong to Stage 3B.2.
